title: 24 Game Solver
description: Solve the 24 game exhaustively: every ordering, operation and parenthesization is tried with exact fraction arithmetic, and all distinct solutions are shown.
howto: Press Solve — the tool tries all 4! orders × 64 operation combos × 5 parenthesizations.
Read every distinct expression that equals 24, using + − × ÷ and parentheses.
If none exists, the tool says so honestly after the full exhaustive search.

faqs.q: How does the exhaustive search work?
faqs.a: It recursively combines pairs of numbers with +, −, ×, ÷ (both orders for − and ÷) until one value remains, tracking the expression string. With exact fractions there are no floating-point false positives or misses.

faqs.q: Why use fractions instead of decimals?
faqs.a: Expressions like (5 − 1/5) × 5 need exact thirds/fifths. Fraction arithmetic with GCD reduction guarantees a solution is reported only when it is exactly 24.

faqs.q: Do all puzzles have a solution?
faqs.a: No — e.g. 1, 1, 1, 1 cannot make 24. The solver searches the entire space (over 7,000 combinations) before concluding none exists.
